name: draft_refuses_to_apply
comment: A version marked draft (diff --draft; "draft": true here) never applies or baselines: MIG-013 before anything executes, the whole plan refused — V0001 stays unapplied too (the `down` to 0 finds nothing applied; had V0001 been applied, it would have nothing to derive its rollback from). Without the marker the same plan applies.
